interpretation: The MX490 has a concrete stream-processing state machine calling the embedded zlib inflate core. Recovering its state structure and the four stream descriptors is the next loader-analysis step.
caveat: The callsite does not by itself identify application code destinations or establish that a modified image will be accepted by the bootloader.
